historical_record.description: The Works Progress Administration repaired and rehabilitated several buildings on the hospital campus — the nurses' home, the administration building and the pathology, emergency and receiving buildings.

San Francisco General Hospital, where Ward 5B opened in July 1983 as the first dedicated inpatient AIDS ward in the world, staffed by eleven nurses and two unit clerks who volunteered. Identified as potentially eligible for landmark designation.
